name: Las Vegas Poker
author: Addicting Games
description: Step into the glitzy world of Las Vegas Poker, where the stakes are high, and the mood is sly. Dive into a virtual casino experience filled with colorful characters, questionable bluffing tactics, and the occasional poker face. Test your skills against these poker mastermind AI opponents that will have you hoping for a royal flush. Whether you're a seasoned pro or a novice at the tables, Las Vegas Poker promises all the excitement of a night in sin city from the comfort of your desk.
